spec.goal: I can identify nouns as masculine or feminine and make them plural when naming things.

topics.title: Noun Gender with -o and -a
topics.covers: Assign masculine and feminine to most nouns by their endings, as in el libro, la casa, el amigo, and la amiga.

topics.title: Gender Patterns and Common Exceptions
topics.covers: Master -ción, -dad, -ma, and traps like el día, la mano, el mapa, el problema, and el agua so you stop guessing.

topics.title: Making Nouns Plural
topics.covers: Form plurals with -s and -es, including the z to c change, in libros, lápices, and canciones.

topics.title: Tricky Plurals: Jóvenes, Exámenes, Los García
topics.covers: Form plurals that shift accents or spelling, such as jóvenes and exámenes, and pluralize surnames and compounds like los García and los sacacorchos.

spec.convo: You and the partner each have a different half of a household inventory; compare lists of items and counts.

lines.es: Mi lista: el libro, la casa y el día.
lines.en: My list: the book, the house and the day.

lines.es: Mi lista: los libros, las casas y los días.
lines.en: My list: the books, the houses and the days.
How nice! One list in singular.
And the other one in plural.

lines.es: Sí, y la mano es femenina.
lines.en: Yes, and the hand is feminine.

lines.es: ¡Muy bien! El problema es pequeño: las dos listas son correctas.
lines.en: Very good! The problem is small: both lists are correct.

questions.question: What is on Mara's list?
choices: A book, a house and a day

convo.setting: You and Diego each have half of a household inventory list. You compare items and counts.
convo.learnerCard: You have half of the inventory. Name your items, say if they are masculine or feminine, give counts, and ask Diego about his list.
convo.learnerCardEs: Tienes la otra lista. Compara los objetos con Diego.
convo.partnerCard: Diego has the other half of the inventory. He names his items and asks about yours.

goals.text: Name two things on your list (Tengo dos libros / Tengo una casa).
Say if an item is masculine or feminine (el libro es masculino / la casa es femenina).
Say how many, in plural (Tengo tres libros / Tengo dos casas).
Ask Diego about his list (¿Y tu lista? / ¿Cuántos libros tienes?).

convo.opening: Yo tengo mi lista. ¿Qué tienes en tu lista?

script.reply: ¡Bien! Yo tengo dos lápices en mi lista.
script.hint: Say "Tengo dos libros y una casa."

script.reply: Sí, el libro es masculino y la casa es femenina.
Mi lista tiene dos lápices y una casa.

nudges.list_items: Di dos cosas de tu lista.
nudges.say_gender: Di el género de un objeto.
nudges.count_plural: Di un número y el plural.
nudges.ask_back: Pregúntale a Diego por su lista.

convo.closing: ¡Gracias! Las dos listas son completas. ¡Hasta luego!

reads.question: Which word is masculine?
